light_description: Japanese vintage TS-808 clone in the compact SUMO STOMP line; official catalog positions it as a vintage-clone overdrive and later documents a Final Edition after vintage Raytheon 4558 stock was exhausted.
Final production state of SUMO #8 with documented vintage parts and construction changes; retained as a meaningful production-state relationship rather than a wholly separate family.
TS-808-based overdrive tuned toward the 1984 SRV Rockpalast sound; later Ver.3 adds a bottom-frequency control and expands bass use.
Limited pedal based on #8TEX with faster response and wider range; official page identifies it as a distinct limited production model built from the #8TEX platform.
Vintage early TS-9 black-label serial 165160 clone documented in the current SUMO STOMP catalog.
Compact clone of an early Klon Centaur three-digit serial #873 specimen, with documented attention to tone, gain, tone behavior and buffer character.
Special milled-aluminum enclosure edition of Longtail #873; retained as a physical edition rather than a new conceptual pedal family.
Bass-tuned derivative of Longtail #873 based on an early Centaur #873 specimen; official/dealer documentation identifies it as a bass-oriented overdrive and line-level-capable design.
Limited vintage Triangle Big Muff clone focused on a 1972 specimen, using measured/selected vintage-style parts and preserving the original-style power switching arrangement.
2026 vintage-modified overdrive based on a 1973 Colorsound Overdriver specimen, adding Master Volume while combining vintage and current parts.
